The Tempest.text: When you Offer, you may destroy a face-up card on the Altar.
The Tempest.why: Destroys like Raphael and Azazel: a face-up card, on a turn you Offer (V44). Was the strongest Celestial (1.12)

The Oracle.text: In the Morning: Look at the top 2 Event cards. Play one, and put the other on the bottom of the Event deck.
The Oracle.why: A real choice of the Day's Event (V44). Was 0.92

The Eclipse.text: In the Evening: Choose a card in your Choir. It counts as Neutral at this Day's Reaping.

The Cantor.text: When you Offer, you may Offer a second card of the same alignment (Light, Dark, or Neutral). Both go face up, and each earns its reward.
The Cantor.why: A chorus: a matching pair, sung aloud like Hymn (V44). With a second reward on every turn it measured 1.13 to 1.18

The Patron.text: On your turn: Play a card from your hand into another player's Choir. If it is full, they discard one of its cards first.
The Patron.why: Worded like Temptation, and Targeting like it (V44)

The Echo.text: On your turn: Use the On your turn ability of a card in another player's Choir, as if it were yours. Spent cards cannot be copied.
The Echo.why: Timing label; says what it can copy (V44)

The Dominion.text: Your hand limit is 5 instead of 3. Begin the game with 5 cards in hand.
The Dominion.why: A hand of 5 (was 4): with every other Celestial working, 4 measured 0.88 to 0.94 (V44)

The Whisper.text: In the Morning: Name Light or Dark aloud. At the Reaping, if the Tide matches, your Choir counts as leaning with it.
The Whisper.why: Timing label and the current scoring words (V44)

The Arbiter.text: When you gain Glory at the Reaping, take 1 of it from another player: one whose Choir leaned against the Tide, if any of them has Glory.
The Arbiter.why: The losers pay the winner; it no longer gives away its losses (V44). Was the weakest Celestial (0.84)

Divine Calling.text: When you Exalt this Day, gain 1 Glory.
Divine Calling.why: Exalt has been free since V42, so the old text did nothing (V44)

Purgatory.text: No Choir loses Glory at the Reaping this Day. A Choir that leans neither way gains 1 Glory.
Purgatory.why: A Day of reprieve instead of a tax on every Choir; the Tide still pays (V44)

The Fast.text: No one may Exalt, Turn, or spend Glory this Day.
The Fast.why: Exalt is free, so it is named on its own (V44)

Famine.text: No Choir gains or loses Glory at the Reaping this Day, and no Choir counts as leaning with or against the Tide.
Famine.why: The current scoring words; says what cards that ask about the Tide see (V44)

Ascension.text: Light cards on the Altar count double when the Tide is set.
Ascension.why: Counts every card on the Altar, First Fruits included (V44)

Fall From Grace.text: Dark cards on the Altar count double when the Tide is set.
Fall From Grace.why: Counts every card on the Altar, First Fruits included (V44)
